architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management library (use React context for global state). Minimal dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom. Build tool: Vite. TypeScript optional but recommended for maintainability.

tickets.title: Convert jastip_home_screen_mobile to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/JastipHome.jsx. Replicate exact layout, colors, typography from Stitch HTML. Mobile-first responsive. Extract reusable components: Header, ProductCard, Footer. Use CSS modules for styling. Hardcode mock data for now.
acceptance_criteria: Pixel-perfect match to Stitch design on mobile viewport (375px width)
All interactive elements (buttons, links) visually match hover/active states
No console errors
Responsive: scales to 768px width without horizontal scroll

tickets.title: Convert jastip_order_form_mobile to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/JastipOrderForm.jsx. Replicate form fields, labels, validation states. Extract reusable components: OrderFormField, OrderSummary. Use native HTML5 form validation. CSS modules for styling. Hardcode mock data for order summary.
acceptance_criteria: All form fields match Stitch design (input types, placeholders, labels)
Validation states (error, success) visually identical
Form submission disabled until required fields filled
Mobile viewport only (375px width)

tickets.title: Convert jastip_catalog_jepang_trip_1 and jastip_catalog_jepang_trip_2 to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/JastipCatalog.jsx. Combine both Stitch screens into single page with tabbed navigation. Extract reusable components: CatalogItem, FilterBar. CSS modules for styling. Hardcode mock catalog data.
acceptance_criteria: Tab navigation switches between trip 1 and trip 2 content
Catalog items match Stitch design (image, title, price, badge)
Filter bar functional (visual feedback only, no backend integration)
Responsive: mobile (375px) and tablet (768px) viewports

tickets.title: Convert thirtyspace_login_register_mobile to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/AuthPage.jsx. Replicate login/register tabs, form fields, social login buttons. Extract reusable components: AuthForm, SocialLoginButton. Use native HTML5 form validation. CSS modules for styling. No backend integration yet.
acceptance_criteria: Tab navigation switches between login/register forms
Form fields match Stitch design (input types, placeholders, labels)
Social login buttons visually identical
Form submission disabled until required fields filled
Mobile viewport only (375px width)

tickets.title: Convert thirtyspace_404_navigation_bento_variant to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/NotFound.jsx. Replicate 404 layout, navigation bento, and error message. Extract reusable component: NavigationBento. CSS modules for styling. Hardcode navigation links.
acceptance_criteria: 404 page matches Stitch design (error message, bento layout)
Navigation bento links functional (route to respective pages)
Responsive: mobile (375px) and desktop (1200px) viewports

tickets.title: Create shared UI component library from showcase screens
tickets.description: Create src/components/ui/ directory. Implement reusable components: Button, Badge, Input, Loader, Table, Sidebar. Use CSS modules for styling. Support all variants shown in Stitch showcase screens. No business logic.
acceptance_criteria: All component variants match Stitch showcase designs
Components support all props needed for showcase variants (size, color, state)
No console errors
Components reusable across all pages

tickets.title: Convert thirtyspace_hero_section to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/Home.jsx. Replicate hero section layout, typography, CTA buttons. Extract reusable component: HeroSection. CSS modules for styling. Hardcode content.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section matches Stitch design (background, typography, buttons)
CTA buttons visually identical (hover/active states)
Responsive: mobile (375px) and desktop (1200px) viewports

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create src/App.jsx. Implement app shell with navigation bar. Set up React Router v6 routes for all pages. Navigation bar matches Stitch design (mobile menu, desktop layout). Use lazy loading for routes. Add 404 route.
acceptance_criteria: All pages accessible via navigation bar
Navigation bar matches Stitch design (mobile/desktop variants)
Routes lazy-loaded
404 page shown for unknown routes
No console errors
Responsive: mobile (375px) and desktop (1200px) viewports
